snps.description: CYP1A2*1F allele. Determines caffeine metabolism speed. AA = fast metabolizer, AC/CC = slow metabolizer.
snps.effect: AA = Fast metabolizer, can consume more caffeine. CC = Slow metabolizer, caffeine lasts longer, increased cardiovascular risk with high intake.

snps.description: Adenosine A2A receptor. T allele = higher caffeine sensitivity (anxiety, jitteriness).
snps.effect: TT genotype = More sensitive to caffeine's stimulating effects, more anxiety/jitteriness

snps.description: Another CYP1A2 variant affecting caffeine metabolism
COMT enzyme variant. Affects dopamine breakdown and caffeine sensitivity.
snps.effect: Met carriers (AA) may be more sensitive to caffeine's anxiety-inducing effects

snps.description: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor - regulates CYP1A2 expression
